lead: Open-source tools for multilingual websites, and the sites we design and build with our partners.
i18n_text: Internationalization for SvelteKit. One install brings the core and the Curly parser, wired into hooks, layouts and components: one instance per request on the server, one per tab in the browser.
curly_text: A small message syntax for software translations. Values go into double-curly placeholders that may carry a modifier, options and a fallback. A message always resolves; what went wrong is reported on a channel of its own.
cesta_text: Your way to the news: articles from Czech publishers in one feed, with likes, comments and the authors you follow. We take part in its design and development.
